identity.name: MLA Contract Portal
identity.vibe: The Digital Blueprint - Precise, Authoritative, Efficient

usage.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-mono

rules: Use dense grids for dashboards (grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12)
Always use 1px borders to separate content areas
Avoid large white spaces in data views; keep it compact
Use 'Bento' style asymmetry for the project overview

style_overrides.button: rounded-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-xs h-10 px-6
style_overrides.badge: rounded-none font-mono uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest px-2 py-0.5

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on sidebar or dark backgrounds
visual_enhancers.decorations: Technical lines, crosshairs at intersections, blueprint-style grids
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, precise transitions (duration-200 ease-out). No bounce.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the main dashboard.
Use Manrope for all headings and JetBrains Mono for all numbers/dates/IDs.
Keep the UI flat and border-heavy. Avoid drop shadows.
Use the Safety Orange (#f97316) sparingly for alerts, deadlines, and active states.
Ensure the Client Portal is read-only and extremely simple (mostly lists and status cards).
Use the 'hero_construction' image for the login page background with a heavy dark overlay.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for overlays/modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
